parsed.notes: The excerpt names a maximum Leverage Ratio covenant in the Credit Agreement but gives neither the actual ratio nor the limit. It says only that the company was in compliance as of 2026-08-31 and that the covenant capped additional debt at $277.3 million. The 3.25x Leverage Ratio is a pro-forma condition for the accordion feature, not a maintenance covenant. The Net Leverage Ratio only sets the interest margin and fees. Both are excluded.
